checks: Blank left drag pans the board in both axes at 1x without changing papers.
Fixed camera snapshot prevents pan drift; wheel is ignored during a held pan.
Space + left drag and middle drag pan from a paper without moving or selecting it.
Pointer cancellation, lost capture and window blur all release pan state.
Fullscreen uses the same scene/canvas/renderer, centers the board head-on and hides surrounding navigation.
Fullscreen supports pan/zoom/reset, and exiting restores the exact previous overview zoom and center.
Plain left drag still moves/persists papers; fullscreen editing preserves Space, and Escape blurs text before exiting.
Switching sessions exits fullscreen and restores isolated session papers.
Fullscreen hides the neighbouring array and rack without removing their objects, and exit restores visibility.
Portrait fullscreen toolbar and editor fit the viewport; papers remain selectable and exit stays accessible.
environment: Chromium / SwiftShader. Intermediate GL draws are skipped; screenshot frames use the production renderer. This is an interaction and visual check, not a GPU performance benchmark.
runNotes: Pan checks passed in the first interaction run. Fullscreen checks were rerun after hiding neighbouring props.

The combined harness then waited for a board toolbar after switching sessions had correctly returned to the array. Portrait controls, paper selection, editor bounds and exit were subsequently rerun from the board in a separate successful browser run.
